7. Review and records
Managers must review every remote working arrangement at least once per quarter and record the outcome in the HR system. Employees may request an additional review at any time.

8. Data handling
Remote staff must use the company VPN when handling customer data. Personal devices must not store client files for longer than seven days.

9. Amendments
This policy is reviewed each January by the People Operations team. Amendments take effect on the first day of the month after approval.
